entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Testigo nankue
Nas Kakaravíco,
Manan hizana
Yuesanguasi nagasanangüasi.
Iva testigo name maguasiri avinaskaví mare nómasina guneri,
Ayua Zakaravico cuni maimani.
Be maseingunamase gacaca
Bema nenán avuankin.
